summary.en: The contact sheet: every film as a strip as long as the film; the longer strips pull out one after another, the measured lengths are set, two captions under the sheet.
summary.zh: 印样：每支片一条和片长一样长的胶片；较长的依次拉长，写出量出的时长，印样下方两句说明。

fits: A claim about lengths, versions or measured renders.
notFor: A set whose lengths are all equal (nothing to pull).

intent.en: The proof is the lengths themselves, measured, on one baseline.
intent.zh: 证据就是长度本身：量过，并排在同一基线上。

content.en: 1–10 rows (name, duration, row strip); 1–2 captions (≤ 6 words / 16 字).

fits.zh: 关于时长、版本或实测渲染的主张。

notFor.zh: 时长全都一样的一组（没有可拉长的）。

fits: any film about films, frames or renders

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
